notes: IB Tracker now runs natively on Apple Silicon. Until now it was an Intel build running through Apple's Rosetta translation layer, which is why macOS had started warning that it "includes a component that will not work with a future release of macOS". That warning is gone, and the app is faster and lighter for it.
This download needs an Apple Silicon Mac — an M1 or newer. If you have an older Intel Mac, don't install it: stay on the version you have, which keeps working and keeps updating.
